title: MycoMayhem
description: This mod is an all in one adding building blocks food and weapons
body:
MycoMayhem is a chaotic mushroom-powered expansion that transforms Minecraft’s fungi into tools of survival, combat, building, and bizarre cuisine. In this world, spores aren’t harmless they’re power.

At the core of the mod is a new fungal progression system. Using the Mushroom Mutator—crafted with 2 iron ingots, a brewing stand, and 2 red mushrooms—you can create two unique mushroom types: the Puffball Mushroom and the Glowshroom. These strange fungi unlock everything the mod has to offer.

![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8320a88978a934156c1fbd51ce3b65fef7d1e79d.png)

From these, you can forge shroomite, a powerful material created using 1 glowshroom, 1 diamond, and 1 iron ingot. Shroomite is the backbone of your gear and survival.

![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2cce36f5d19a24f5f2b816da2f629c491cafd677.png)

The highlight is the Shroomite Sword—crafted with 2 shroomite ingots and a stick. This isn’t just a weapon. Right-clicking launches you backwards, letting you escape danger instantly in a burst of fungal energy (with a cooldown, so timing matters).

![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/266fa8fafb81fa1adc91fc30f7001f4dad731bdd.png)

For utility, equip the Shroomite Hat, which grants Haste and Night Vision, turning you into a fast and efficient underground explorer.

![Shroomite Hat](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5bdd41554c1ad15cb2316fb121191e38147739b8.png)

MycoMayhem also expands your building options with a full Glowshroom wood set and decorative tiles, letting you create eerie, glowing fungal structures.

And of course, the food:

Glowshroom Stew: grants Glowing and Haste, making you visible but faster.

![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0f3978cd4b9d0b53b2101fcd8a71dd834566e3d4.png)

Puffball Stew: a stronger, more nourishing version of mushroom stew.

![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6f555811012883bb39711f77560d000a0b832a3d.png)

Whether you’re crafting powerful gear, escaping danger with spore-fueled mobility, building glowing mushroom bases, or experimenting with strange new foods, MycoMayhem brings chaotic fungal energy into every part of your world.

Embrace the spores.
